poll_interval
concurrency
request_timeout
rate_limit

at=datetime(2026,10,18,20,30,tzinfo=timezone.utc)
class QueryClock(datetime):
 @classmethod
 def now(cls,tz=None): return at.astimezone(tz) if tz else at.replace(tzinfo=None)
t=RelativePostedSourceIntakeTests('test_public_intake_excludes_two_hours_ago_from_last_hour')
results=[]

 t.setUp();t.collected_at=at

 t.payload['jobs']=[]
 for i,claim in enumerate(claims):
  row=deepcopy(template);row.update(id=3000+i,publication_date=claim,url=f'https://remotive.com/remote-jobs/it/{3000+i}')
  t.payload['jobs'].append(row)
 t.payload['job-count']=len(claims)
 t._collect();t._reopen()
 cases=[('LAST_HOUR',list(range(2)),{}),('TODAY',list(range(4)),{}),('LAST_24_HOURS',list(range(6)),{}),('LAST_3_DAYS',list(range(8)),{}),('LAST_7_DAYS',list(range(10)),{}),('LAST_30_DAYS',list(range(12)),{}),('CUSTOM',[5,6,7],{'date_start':(at-timedelta(days=3)).isoformat(),'date_end':(at-timedelta(days=1)).isoformat()})]
 with patch('services.discovery.search_semantics.datetime',QueryClock):
  for window,ids,bounds in cases:

   saved=t.client.get('/search-profiles',params={'profile_id':'fixture'}).json()['search_profiles']
   persisted=next(x for x in saved if x['id']==body['id']);assert persisted['criteria']['date_window']==window
   response=t.client.get('/jobs',params={'profile_id':'fixture','search_profile_id':body['id']});assert response.status_code==200,response.text
   actual=sorted(x['attributes']['native_posting_id'] for x in response.json()['jobs']);expected=[3000+i for i in ids]
   results.append({'window':window,'expected':expected,'actual':actual,'pass':actual==expected});assert actual==expected,results[-1]
  bad=t.client.put('/search-profiles',json={**body,'date_start':at.isoformat(),'date_end':(at-timedelta(days=1)).isoformat()});assert bad.status_code==422,bad.text
 print(json.dumps({'source':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip(),'utc':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),'fixture_claims':claims,'reference':at.isoformat(),'checks':results,'inverted_custom_status':bad.status_code,'limits':'synthetic HTTP boundary; production direct execute_operation; SQLite reopen/public saved search+GET; fixed query clock; no RQ/browser/live provider'},indent=2))
